desc: Ideation complete: model as a functional graph and identify that only pure cycles require an extra temporary-letter operation.
Implement target-map consistency check and compute used_count, non-self edge count, and indegree per target (including self-edges).
Count pure cycles: nontrivial directed cycles where every node has original indegree 1.
Apply buffer condition (unused source letter or any indegree >= 2) and output -1 if pure cycles exist without buffer, otherwise edges + pure_cycles.

Validate with samples and edge cases: identical strings, full 26-letter permutation cycle, cycle with incoming edge, all 26 letters used with indegree >= 2, and self-loop components that create a buffer.
